headline: Debt Markets Demand Higher Collateral for Tech AI Financing
summary: Bond markets are demanding higher collateral and yields from technology companies raising debt, marking a tightening in credit conditions for AI capital spending.
why: Debt market conditions dictate borrowing costs for technology mega-caps financing multi-billion dollar artificial intelligence data center infrastructure.

impacts.name: US Technology Corporate Debt
impacts.why: Lenders demanding higher yields and collateral reduced debt market pricing terms for tech borrowers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bond investor caution over tech leverage and AI return timelines drove borrowing yields higher.
